answer: Admission needs a reef of endorsements: each new identity must present 5 endorsements from distinct established identities, each endorser staking 2,000 POA, slashable if the newcomer is caught farming, and each endorser may spend at most 2 endorsement slots per epoch. A plume of clones hits the same wall: every extra clone needs 5 fresh endorsements, the delta is 5 more scarce slots plus 10,000 POA of newly at-risk stake, and slots cannot be bulk-bought because the endorser pool is fixed per epoch. The registry checks endorsements at intake and burns the stake on a proven sybil verdict.
